lines.text: After finishing his prayer, Solomon rose from kneeling before the altar and blessed all Israel in a loud voice.
Solomon blessed the LORD for giving rest to Israel and asked that He never leave or forsake them.
Solomon wanted all the peoples of the earth to know that the LORD is God.
Solomon offered 22,000 oxen and 120,000 goats as peace offerings, and the people dedicated the house of the LORD.
People from Dan to Beersheba kept the feast fourteen days, and on the fifteenth day Solomon sent them home.
